children: Equinor ASA Sponsored ADR (OSL:EQNR) is balancing shareholder returns, buying back shares to reach 18,103,431 held (0.76%), while advancing production and clean‑energy projects—from a potentially winter‑starting Adura/Jackdaw gas output that could supply ~6% of UK gas to the newly operational 100 MW Citrus Flatts battery—and trading refined gasoline cargoes in global markets.
: Equinor (EQNR) started its third 2026 buyback tranche Jul 23–Oct 26. From Aug 24–28 it bought 720,516 shares at NOK 388.0749, now holding 18,103,431 own shares (0.76%).
Adura/Jackdaw Gas Project UK Approval Expected
: Equinor ASA Sponsored ADR (EQNR) co-owns the Adura/Jackdaw gas project; UK approval expected Sept 15. If cleared, production could start this winter, peaking near 40,000 boe/d and ~6% UK gas.
: Equinor ASA Sponsored ADR (EQNR) brought the 100 MW Citrus Flatts battery storage facility online in Texas. Facility now operational and adds 100 MW to Equinor’s U.S. project portfolio.
: Equinor ASA ADR (EQNR) sold ~11,000 t gasoline E5 by barge to buyers including Vitol, Varo, Sahara, Gunvor and Trafigura; also involved in ~6,000 t gasoline E10 barge trades.
This is an AI-generated summary and may contain inaccuracies. Please verify any important information with the original sources.

title: Weekly Recap: Third 2026 buyback tranche and Adura/Jackdaw UK approval expected
